title: AuthorityHeadObservedPayload
description: Payload of the AuthorityHeadObserved heartbeat (catalogued in model/architecture/events.yaml; class: platform, INV-REQ-1226, INV-Q-17070 B; topic gst.platform.authority-head-observed.v1; written under the platform tenant with the platform entity). access-svc publishes it every 500 ms so that an authority replica measures its lag against a known head and counts silence of more than 1000 ms as a lost feed (INV-REQ-1201, INV-Q-9047). Within a major version this schema is additive-only (API-41, FR-K.4).

authorityVersion.description: The highest authorityVersion among the AuthorityChanged events access-svc has committed; never a drawn sequence value, so a replica at this version has applied every committed change (INV-REQ-1201 b1).

incarnation.description: Optional incarnation (epoch) of the authority sequence (INV-REQ-1201, INV-Q-9243 B). Versions order within one incarnation; the order across incarnations is by incarnation first, then authorityVersion. An absent value means 1 (a producer that predates this change).
